Contrail Aviation Support, a unit of Air T
Stuart G. Weinroth as CEO, succeeding founder Joe Kuhn.
Weinroth brings 30+ years of commercial aviation experience and joins Contrail from Air Transport Services Group, where he helped expand its aircraft and engine businesses.
The leadership change follows 26 years of growth under Kuhn and Miriam Cohen-Kuhn, who built Contrail into a global narrow-body aircraft and engine trading business.
The company said Weinroth’s appointment is intended to maintain continuity while supporting Contrail’s continued growth and collaboration across Air T’s aviation businesses.

title: Contrail Aviation names new CEO as Founder Joe Kuhn steps down
